sources.entry: pytest - A mature full-featured Python testing tool.

summary.one_liner: pytest is a mature, full-featured Python testing framework that lets you write small tests with plain assert statements and scale up to complex functional testing of applications and libraries.
summary.what_it_does: The README shows a simple test file using plain assert statements and a failing example where pytest prints introspected values (e.g. "assert 4 == 5"). It describes auto-discovery of test modules and functions, and modular fixtures for managing small or parametrized long-lived test resources. It states that pytest can run unittest (or trial) test suites out of the box. It supports Python 3.10+ and PyPy3. It has a plugin architecture, which the README says has over 1300 external plugins.
use_cases: writing unit tests for Python code
notable: Detailed assertion introspection using plain assert statements
Runs unittest and trial test suites out of the box
Over 1300 external plugins per the README
caveats: Full documentation, installation and tutorials are hosted externally (the README links to them rather than including them)
